name: Michael I of Romania
contribution: The last king of Romania, reigning from 20 July 1927 to 8 June 1930 and again from 6 September 1940 until his forced abdication on 30 December 1947.

checks.lead: Michael I (Romanian: Mihai I Romanian: [miˈhaj ɨnˈtɨj] ; 25 October 1921 – 5 December 2017) was the last king of Romania, reigning from 20 July 1927 to 8 June 1930 and again from 6 September 1940 until his forced abdication on 30 December 1947.
